extra_pruned_groups.reason: large group (8 cols), delta = -0.000853 (negative — removal helps), well within noise but non-positive; no leakage concern, no positive contribution demonstrated; dead weight, cut overfit surface + train cost

per_fold_aggregates.rationale: Fold-aware target encodings and sub-target aggregates are systematically undervalued by single HGB ablation because per-fold recomputation adds noise on each held-out slice. Delta barely negative and well below prune_margin; these are canonical panel anchor features the tuned CatBoost/LGBM stack reliably exploits. Retain.

text_svd.rationale: Delta negative (removal helps) and trivially small; 8 SVD columns with no demonstrated positive contribution constitute dead weight enlarging the overfit surface.

image_features.rationale: Positive delta (removal hurts); static per (jurisdiction, period_id) — no leakage. Within noise but net positive direction; retain.

datetime_derived.rationale: Delta above prune_margin; clear unambiguous contributor. Keep.

other_features.rationale: Positive delta; contains target lags and rolling windows essential for time-series. Keep.
